fusions.name: Seagrass Drift
fusions.desc: Drifts a mat of seagrass over every enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 10 damage, stripping 12% armour for 6 seconds, slowing each by 25% and pushing it back 2 tiles.

fusions.name: Bladderwrack Lob
fusions.desc: Lobs a heavy frond of bladderwrack at one enemy, dealing 26 damage. When it hits, every ally deals 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Seagrass Meadow
fusions.desc: Grows a meadow of seagrass where you stand. For 10 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

fusions.name: Unhurried Graze
fusions.desc: When you are healed, you restore 5 stamina. Once every 6 seconds.
